title: nuphar lutea subsp. ulvacea

This aquatic plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential source for the development of new pharmaceuticals.
